item.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published a call for evidence on the tokenisation of collateral posted to central counterparties (CCPs) and is inviting a public hearing on 7 January 2027 from 09:30 to 17:00 at its premises at 201–203 rue de Bercy in Paris, and online, the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway (Finanstilsynet) said on 18 November 2026. Registration closes on 16 December 2026, and written comments are due by 15 January 2027. The hearing and the call for evidence are set out on ESMA’s website.
